game_title: Infinite Loop Trap – Mushroom Cavern Streak
game_concept: A quiz RPG set in Shadow Cave – Mushroom Cavern, a cavern of glowing mushrooms: the dwarf scout must handle zombies while practicing control flow: while loops. Core idea – Infinite Loop Trap: Find the missing update line that makes a loop never stop, before zombies overload Mushroom Cavern.
theme: Shadow Cave – Mushroom Cavern: a cavern of glowing mushrooms
core_gameplay_loop: In Mushroom Cavern, repeat each round: Find the missing update line that makes a loop never stop, before zombies overload Mushroom Cavern. Each round poses one decision; a wrong answer breaks the streak. Then check the loop_safety value and advance.
player_objective: Chain 6 consecutive correct decisions about loop_safety to power up the dwarf scout and open the supply cache.
controls: Mouse/touch: drag code blocks into the editor panel; SPACE runs the code; keys 1-4 pick answers.
lose_condition: lives reach 0 (each wrong decision costs a life and resets the streak).
learning_alignment: Week 4 – Control Flow: While Loops | Level 3 (intro tier): Infinite Loop Trap
assets_style: dark pixel-art cavern: torchlit stone, mossy rock, deep shadows, glowing crystals; flat Kenney-style sprites; echoing drips, low drones and torch crackle
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Infinite Loop Trap' (Week 4 slot 4), mission type 'Streak Challenge', and setting 'Mushroom Cavern'. code_snippet:
while n < 5:
    print(n)  # n never changes
tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how loop_safety changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against zombies in Mushroom Cavern.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: streak counter reaches 6.
